column3: Ben has 5 apples. He gets 2 more. How many apples does he have?
Mia has 9 balloons. 3 pop. How many are left?
There are 8 ducks. 2 swim away. How many stay?
Tom has 4 toy cars. He gets 5 more. How many has he now?
Lily picks 10 flowers. She gives away 4. How many are left?
There are 7 birds. 1 flies away. How many are left?
Sam has 6 pencils. He finds 3 more. How many pencils has he now?
Ava has 8 sweets. She eats 2. How many are left?
There are 3 cats and 2 dogs. How many animals are there?
Jack has 10 marbles. He loses 5. How many are left?
Ella has 4 books. She buys 4 more. How many books does she have?
There are 9 fish. 4 swim away. How many are left?
Noah has 7 stickers. He gets 1 more. How many stickers has he now?
